summary: Analyzes agreements between network providers for delivering quality of service across the whole Internet. It defines terms for inter-domain QoS and proposes the Meta-QoS-Class concept as a way to link providers' service classes while keeping the Internet as open as best-effort service. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Different delivery companies each have their own priority levels. This paper suggests a shared set of labels, so a rush package stays rushed across companies.
